title: FAMILY, KINSHIP AND REVOLUTION: THE RUSSIAN NOBILITY, 1917-23
text:
# FAMILY, KINSHIP AND REVOLUTION: THE RUSSIAN NOBILITY, 1917-23

Family & Community History. Published: 2005-05-01. 5 citations.

## Abstract

This article examines the importance of family and kin to the Russian nobility during the Russian Revolution. It focuses on the experiences of four interrelated families to show how nobles used family connections for a variety of purposes prior to I9I7. This helped them to maintain their predominant position within tsarist society. The article argues that these links continued after the revolution, helping nobles survive everyday hardship and official persecution under the new regime; in some cases, surprisingly large family ‘communities’ of nobles emerged. These communities persisted into the I920S and even when they disbanded the wider family maintained its central position in noble life.
